append.text: **Canticle 215 (Isa 45:16, 17, 29)** *Confúsi sunt, et erubuérunt … non confundémini, et non erubescétis … confundéntur omnes* → *Foram envergonhados, e coraram … não sereis envergonhados, e não corareis … serão envergonhados todos*; *in confusiónem* → *para a vergonha*. No reader remarked on the verb.
**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:16, 17)** *coraram*, *não corareis*, paired with *confúndi* as here. The ambiguity reader listed *coraram* as unknown; kept.

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:17) *usque in sǽculum sǽculi* → *pelos séculos dos séculos*** — no precedent in the psalter for *usque* with this formula; D27's words kept, *usque* left inside *pelos* (MS1932 the same). D37's *para todo o sempre* is the option.

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:20) *Non in abscóndito locútus sum, * in loco terræ tenebróso* → *Não falei às escondidas, * num lugar tenebroso da terra*** — with a verb of speaking, the adverbial use (9:30a; DRB 'in secret', MS1932 *às ocultas*). The v2 Latinist read it as a place, parallel to *in loco*; *em lugar escondido* is the option (decision `abscondito`).

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:18) the noun *plastes* (πλάστης, 'moulder', L&S citing this verse)** → *ele próprio, o seu modelador*. Draft 1 *ele próprio a moldou* (this row's verb) was refused by the Latinist: the Latin has a noun in apposition. See the new *plastes* row.

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:24) *consiliámini simul*, the nations summoned to deliberate, no object** → *tomai conselho juntos* (MS1932), a local departure: *planejai* wants an object, *aconselhai-vos* is heard as 'seek advice'. The ambiguity reader heard 'deliberate'. Proposal: this row keeps *planejar* for plotting (30:14), *tomar conselho* for deliberation.

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:16) the noun *fabricatóres errórum* → *os fabricantes de erros*** (MS1932; DRB 'forgers of errors'). *forjadores* (128:3's verb) is the option. The ambiguity reader did not hear the idol sense; the Latin says errors.

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:30) passive, of God's justifying: *In Dómino justificábitur* → *No Senhor será justificada*** (as 142:2 *será justificado*; the Brazilian Lectionary the same). The passive is not heard as 'make excuses'.

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:30) *In Dómino justificábitur, et laudábitur omne semen Israël* → *No Senhor será justificada e louvada toda a descendência de Israel*** — this row's build; the Lectionary and DM1962 say *glorificada*, which is the option.
**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:25) *Numquid non ego Dóminus* → *Acaso não sou eu o Senhor*** (the Brazilian Lectionary the same).

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:25) *Deus justus, et salvans non est præter me* → *Deus justo e que salve não há senão eu*** — kept apart from *absque me* → *além de mim* in the same verse. The stylist's *fora de mim* (MS1932) is the option.
**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:29) *meæ sunt justítiæ et impérium* → *estão as minhas justiças e o domínio***. The ambiguity reader noted *domínio* as a territory, second.

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:26) *Convertímini ad me … omnes fines terræ* → *Convertei-vos a mim*** — D25's exception (men told to turn to God); the Brazilian LH and Lectionary say *Voltai-vos para mim*, the option.

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:27) *In memetípso jurávi* → *Por mim mesmo jurei***; and 45:28 *jurábit omnis lingua* → *jurará toda língua* — Isaiah's Latin, not Paul's *confitébitur* (Rom 14:11; Phil 2:11 *confiteátur*), which follows the Greek.
**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:21, 45:30)** *sémini Jacob* → *à descendência de Jacó*; *omne semen Israël* → *toda a descendência de Israel* (the Lectionary the same).

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:23) *lignum sculptúræ suæ* → *o seu lenho esculpido*** — the genitive made an adjective; *escultura* avoided as art (this row). The v2 Latinist's *o lenho da sua escultura* and *a sua madeira esculpida* are options. The ambiguity reader listed *lenho* as unknown.
**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:23) *rogant deum non salvántem* → *rogam a um deus que não salva***. Listed unknown by the ambiguity reader; kept.

**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:28) *mihi curvábitur omne genu* → *a mim se dobrará todo joelho*** — of a knee Portuguese says *dobrar* (every Brazilian text; Paul's *flectétur* the same image); *curvar* kept for backs and souls. *se curvará* is the option. See the new formula *Quia mihi curvábitur omne genu*.
**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:16, 22, 24)** *juntos* ×3.
**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:22) *Congregámini* → *Reuni-vos*** (the enclitic makes it safe, D13); the CNBB LH the same.
**Canticle 215 (Isa 45:22) *accédite simul* → *aproximai-vos juntos*** (= 33:6).

append.text: **Canticle 215 (Isa 45:19, 21)** *in vanum* and *frustra* → *em vão*; at 45:21 *frustra* is kept where the Latin sets it, between the saying and *Quǽrite me*, so it can belong to either (decision `frustra`).

terms: | plastes (God as the earth's moulder) | modelador (*ele próprio, o seu modelador*) | open | Canticle 215 (Isa 45:18); not in the psalter. πλάστης, 'moulder, potter' (L&S cites this verse for 'creator, maker'); DRB 'the very maker thereof'. Same root as plasmáre → *moldar*. The Latinist asked for the noun; *artífice* and the verb *a moldou* are options. |
| fabricátor | fabricante (*os fabricantes de erros*) | open | Canticle 215 (Isa 45:16) *fabricatóres errórum*; MS1932 the same. *forjadores* (128:3 *forjaram*) is the option. |

| nescíre (absolute) | *Nada souberam* | open — **for Gustavo** | Canticle 215 (Isa 45:23) *Nesciérunt qui levant …*. 81:5 has *Não souberam, nem entenderam*, completed by the second verb; alone, the v1 stylist heard *Não souberam* as unfinished and asked *Nada*; the v2 Latinist asked *Não souberam* back ('adds an intensifying nothing'). |
| repugnáre (+ dat.) | resistir a (*todos os que lhe resistem*) | open | Canticle 215 (Isa 45:29); not in the psalter. DRB 'resist'; the Brazilian Lectionary the same. |
| audítum fácere | fazer ouvir (*Quem fez ouvir isto desde o início*) | open | Canticle 215 (Isa 45:24); the Latin's build; *anunciar* is annuntiáre's, at the head of the same verse. |
formulas: | *Quia mihi curvábitur omne genu, * et jurábit omnis lingua* (Isa 45:23, canticle 215's 45:28; Paul quotes it in other Latin words, Rom 14:11, Phil 2:10–11) | *Porque a mim se dobrará todo joelho, * e jurará toda língua* | open — canticle 215. *todo joelho* without article (Brazilian 'every'); *jurará* is Isaiah's verb, not Paul's *confessará*. |

| *In Dómino justificábitur et laudábitur omne semen Israël* (Isa 45:25; canticle 215's 45:30; the DM1962 Friday Lauds antiphon) | *No Senhor será justificada e louvada toda a descendência de Israel* | open — follows canticle 215's 45:30. The Lectionary and DM1962 say *glorificada*. |
